import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not line:
        return
    n, a = map(int, line.split())
    
    k = round(a * n / 180)
    if k < 1:
        k = 1
    if k > n - 2:
        k = n - 2
    
    angle_val = k * 180 / n
    diff = abs(angle_val - a)
    
    k_plus = k + 1
    if k_plus <= n - 2:
        angle_val_plus = k_plus * 180 / n
        diff_plus = abs(angle_val_plus - a)
        if diff_plus < diff:
            k = k_plus
    
    v2 = 1
    v1 = 2
    v3 = 2 + k
    
    print(f"{v1} {v2} {v3}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
